system.name: CREATE hardware platform
system.one_liner: a 22nm ASIC implementation of the CREATE accelerator combining systolic PE arrays, distributed LDOs, and anomaly detection units

components.name: Distributed LDO

components.name: PE Array
components.role: 128x128 systolic processing-element array with 8-bit multiplier and 24-bit accumulator per PE, augmented with anomaly detection units

components.name: LDO
components.role: detailed post-PnR layout of a single LDO instance

components.name: Blocks
components.role: area and power breakdown table listing LDO, AD Unit, PE Array, SRAM and Total

content.key_idea: the full CREATE accelerator, built in a 22nm PDK, interleaves distributed LDOs and anomaly-detection units among systolic PE arrays and SRAM buffers at negligible area/power overhead, achieving a 90ns/50mV transient response when scaling voltage in 10mV steps between 0.6V and 0.9V
content.reading_order: top-left (a) full post-PnR chip layout with Distributed LDO, SRAM Buffer and PE Array regions labelled, zoomed via callout to (b) an individual LDO layout, then (c) the area/power breakdown table, and (d)/(e) voltage-scaling waveforms at full and zoomed timescales at the bottom

border/highlight on the zoomed-in LDO layout panel (b)

style.arrows: few thin arrows/leader lines connecting the chip photo to its zoomed LDO detail
style.icons: bitmap, photographic/rendered post-PnR chip layout images occupying most of the figure area

encoding.line_style_means: dashed leader line links the full-chip layout (a) to the zoomed LDO layout (b)

reusable_patterns: post-PnR chip micrograph paired with a zoomed circuit-block layout, an area/power breakdown table, and measured waveform panels
weaknesses: five distinct panel types (photo, zoom, table, two waveform plots) packed into one single-column figure reduces legibility of individual axis labels

evidence: synthesized with a commercial 22 nm PDK at a nominal 0.9 V supply voltage
can dynamically scale the PE array voltage from 0.6 V to 0.9 V in 10 mV steps
achieves 99.8% peak current efficiency and a 90 ns/50 mV transient response time

summary: Figure 12 documents the physical hardware platform built to evaluate CREATE end-to-end. Panel (a) is the post-place-and-route layout of the full accelerator (21.5mm x 15.0mm), with Distributed LDO, SRAM Buffer and PE Array regions labelled; panel (b) zooms into a single LDO instance's layout (216um x 196um). Panel (c) is an area and power breakdown table across LDO, AD (anomaly detection) Unit, PE Array, SRAM and Total blocks, showing the LDO and AD Unit add only 0.08-0.14% area/power overhead. Panels (d) and (e) show example voltage-scaling waveforms at full scale (multiple discrete voltage steps over milliseconds) and zoomed in on one transition (a smooth ramp over microseconds), illustrating the LDO's fast 90ns/50mV transient response. Together the panels ground CREATE's algorithmic contributions in a synthesized 22nm silicon implementation.
summary_zh: 该图展示CREATE硬件平台的物理实现：(a) 完整加速器的后端布局（含分布式LDO、SRAM缓冲区、PE阵列区域标注）；(b) 单个LDO的详细版图；(c) 各模块面积/功耗明细表；(d)(e) 电压调节波形示例（整体时间尺度与瞬态放大），体现LDO和异常检测单元的极低开销及快速响应。
